name: claude-code-usage-pie
description: Monitor Claude Code usage in VS Code with Unicode pie indicators in the status bar

commands.title: Claude Code Usage Pie: Refresh Claude Usage

claudeCodeUsagePie.updateInterval.description: How often usage is refreshed, in seconds.

claudeCodeUsagePie.showNotifications.description: Show warnings when usage exceeds the threshold.

claudeCodeUsagePie.warningThreshold.description: Usage percentage that triggers a warning.

claudeCodeUsagePie.disableApiSync.description: Skip Anthropic's OAuth API entirely (no Keychain read, no network call to api.anthropic.com) and read usage from claudeUsage only.

claudeCodeUsagePie.statusBarTemplate.description: Status bar text template. Supported placeholders: {pie}, {perc}, {percent}. Example pie-only: {pie}.

claudeCodeUsagePie.statusBarSymbols.description: Symbols for usage progression from 0% to 100%. First item is 0%, last item is 100%.

claudeCodeUsagePie.weeklyStatusBarSymbol.description: Optional symbols for weekly (7-day) usage in the status bar. Use {weekPie} in statusBarTemplate to display it. Falls back to statusBarSymbols if empty.

scripts.compile: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js
scripts.package: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js --production
scripts.pretest: npm run compile-tests && npm run compile && npm run lint
